text:
I sincerely apologize. Waiting two hours without a call is completely unacceptable, and I am truly sorry for costing you valuable time away from work. We dropped the ball on our communication, plain and simple. While I’m glad the leak was fixed, you deserved much better service. 

Please call me directly at [Phone Number] so I can make this right., [Your Name], Owner
prompt: I own a small plumbing company. A customer left this 1-star Google review: "Tech showed up 2 hours late and didn't even call. Fixed the leak but I lost half a day of work waiting." Write a reply I can post. Keep it under 70 words, own the mistake, no excuses, and invite them to call me directly.
